purpose: Keep source identity, declared obligation, executed selection, active numerical state, transformed arrays, serialization behavior, decision and costs separately inspectable.

identity: source revision and exact file SHA-256 values
invocation: ordered modality groups and coordinate slices
membership: source file path, bytes and SHA-256
complete ordered input arrays for those rows
comparison: higher-precision formula and result where meaningful
exact dtype, shape and finite checks

required_execution_fields.source_verification: All executed source members match the frozen SHA-256 values and every extracted AST body is named.
required_execution_fields.reduced_boundary: List omitted initializers, injected names, forbidden boundary calls, network guard and whether any forbidden boundary was reached.
required_execution_fields.events: Ordered constructor, set_statistics, apply_state/apply_action, save and reload events with input/output and state digests.
required_execution_fields.selected_state: Record outer mirror and nested active statistics before and after each selection call; a mirror digest cannot substitute for the nested active digest.
required_execution_fields.numeric_outputs: Retain raw inputs and every transformed array with dtype, shape and content digest, including failures.
required_execution_fields.save_reload: Record serialized files and digests, reloaded nested state, output equivalence and eligible domain. Report inverse loss separately.
required_execution_fields.process: Separate exit status, software observation and scientific decision.
required_execution_fields.costs: Outer wall, process CPU, written logical bytes and known/unknown resource scopes.

rule: Support an operation only when an executed selector makes the obligation's exact statistics active and the actual numerical map matches the declared transform on every frozen input.
Keep is supported when override false preserves already-active obligated statistics; a differing outer mirror is reported but is not the active selector.
Replacement or installation is supported only when the candidate is the declared numerical obligation and exact execution makes it active.
Reject an observed replacement or reuse that conflicts with the declared numerical obligation; subset agreement is not an obligation.
Return unresolved when required execution binding or selector evidence is absent, even if source bytes and declarations are valid.
Return invalid for malformed, missing-required-statistic, shape, non-finite or unsupported-dtype input; retain an executed exception as failed when it is not a prevalidated invalid case.
non_authorities: a role, mode or provenance label
a correct digest with an unexecuted or wrong call path

assessment_fields: shared dependencies and independent computation boundary
